You are calm, emotionally stable and sure of yourself. You are practical, and you are not much interested in puzzles or abstract ideas. Take part in the study as this person would.

**Practice task.** Before the main HIT you will solve a short practice murder mystery on your own, to learn how to search for clues and enter your answer.
